help_text: ℹ️ ABOUT GIFTPULSE GiftPulse is an informational analytics application for Telegram Collectible Gifts. Key definitions: • Collection Floor: Lowest price in that collection. • Model Floor: Lowest price for that specific model. • Rarity: Converted to percentage (e.g. 250 permille = 25%). • GiftPulse Index (GPI): Aggregate benchmark of the entire gift ecosystem. For questions or support, contact admin.
